THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
ORDER UNDER PROVISO (a) TO SECTION 38
Order No. 21 of 2019
My Ref. No.: 4-3/15/2018/VE/123.Divisional Secretary’s Ref. No.: DIK/LAN/02/66.

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Proviso (a) to Section 38 ofLand Acquisition Act, (Chapter 460) I, Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms do hereby direct theAcquiring Officer or any other officer authorized by him referred toin Paragraph 1 of the Schedule to take immediate possession of theland specified in the corresponding entry in Paragraph 2 of thatSchedule.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms,“Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwatta Avenue,Battaramulla.03rd January, 2019.
SCHEDULE

02. Description of the land.– The allotments of land depicted inthe Advanced Tracing No. MR/DKW/2018/362 dated 21.09.2018prepared by the Surveyor-General situated in the Village called
Dambagasara in the Minor Division of Wellabada Pattuwa East inthe Divisional Secretary’s Division of Dikwella in Matara District inSouthern Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Iththegodella – Extent: 0.3117 HectareNorth: Ambagahakoratuwa claimed by K. H. Gunawathie,Iththegodella claimed by Wijitha Andarage, Iththegodella claimed byK. G. Amarapala and Baduwatta claimed by Vilbert Wickramasinghe;East: Iththegodella claimed by K. G. Amarapala, Baduwatta claimedby Vilbert Wickramasinghe, Iththegodella of which the claimant couldnot be traced and Iththegodella claimed by A. P. Ariyawathie andsome others; South: Iththegodella claimed by A. P. Ariyawathie andsome others and Lot B; West: Lot B and Ambagahakoratuwa claimedby K. H. Gunawathie.

Denzil; South: Canal andWelipothahena claimed by Kumara; West: Welipothahena claimedby Kumara and Welipothahena claimed by W. H. Somapala.

03. Lot ‘C’ – Welipothahena – Extent: 0.0301 HectareNorth: Canal and Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); East: Road (PradeshiyaSabha) and Bibulagawakoratuwa claimed by U. H. Kamalawathie;South: Bibulagawakoratuwa claimed by U. H. Kamalawathie; West:Bibulagawakoratuwa claimed by U. H. Kamalawathie and Canal.
